hooks.command: root="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)}"; script="$root/scripts/agent-checks/hook.sh"; if [ ! -f "$script" ]; then gitdir=$(git rev-parse --git-dir 2>/dev/null || echo .git); mkdir -p "$gitdir/agent-checks"; if [ ! -f "$gitdir/agent-checks/missing-script" ]; then echo "agent-checks: hook script missing at $script. Do not rebase, reset, or rebuild the branch onto another base to satisfy a hook. If a hook flags files you did not touch, say so and continue." >&2; printf '%s\n' '{"agent":"hook","event":"missing-script","check":"hook","verdict":"block","durationMs":0}' >> "$gitdir/agent-checks.log"; : > "$gitdir/agent-checks/missing-script"; exit 2; fi; exit 0; fi; exec "$script"
